Name: Rose's Cometkins style texture pack for Blue eggs and Gold Mayo
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
A Comkiens'style texture pack for 6480's mod (CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich), with 6480s permission i can publish the mod here. Recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18428]Golden Egg for Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿ (By bunnyverse) with my mod for constantly, since Better Artisan Goods does not have a Gold egg texture. Aslo try my mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35338]Rose's Comkiens Style Mead and Honey patch for BHM[/url]﻿, if you are using Better Honey Mead, it It enables the use of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿’ honey and mead sprites while preserving the color changes and features from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url]﻿ (If you want colored Mead and Honey, Aslo constantly). [b]Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)

[/b]CREDITS
6480 for his amazing mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266](CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url]
Cometkins for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Art Goods mod[/url], inspiring me to make this mod.
